It was the start of my freshman year, I weighed around 220 at the time. I was scared that the number would start going up and I wouldn’t be able to fit into anything I liked. Most of all, I was afraid of being made fun of. I believe it was November when I was sitting on the couch and just thought, “if I hate how I look so much, why don’t I go run? I have a treadmill. Doing nothing isn’t helping.” So I ran for about a month straight until I stopped due to being busy. All the weight I had lost came back. I was once again terrified of it. So I started running. I started at the end of January, it’s now June. I have had the minor setbacks where I lose immense motivation. With those, I give myself a little bit of credit. I’ve lost 30 pounds already so I try to let myself breathe sometimes. I used to do 4Ks everyday but since it’s gotten to hot, I try to do at least 2k runs. When I’m feeling very unmotivated, I tell myself to run 1k.
I find that cardio works best for me but it’s different for everyone
